permission_profile.description: Plan permisos v4 P-5: the mode a new conversation of the project starts in (null: Proyecto/workspace). Set with project.update permission_profile ('' clears it).

learned.description: What Rinari learned by itself about a model's vision (plan 0.4.0 #14); below the owner and the endpoint.

checks.description: Checks actually run before publishing a compaction, and their outcome.

plan_turn_id.description: The PLAN turn a plan_implement / plan_adjust turn acts on (plan 0.4.0 #55).

comment.description: What the owner asked to change in a plan_adjust turn.

team_id.description: Rinari Agency: the team of an office, errand or delivery turn.

errand_id.description: Rinari Agency: the errand this turn does or reviews.

from_label.description: Rinari Agency: who it comes from (the agent that mentioned or asked, or the team that delivered), as the Engine names them.

external_content.description: The turn starts with the external-content guard on: what it got came from outside the machine.

external_source.description: Where that external content came through.

target.description: A scheduled run: this_conversation when it runs in the conversation it was asked in («Repetir aquí»).

task_name.description: A scheduled run in its conversation: the task's name, to show with the message.

browserControl.description: Respuesta de browser.control.set: quien manda y en que revision.

outstanding_mutations.description: Mutaciones admitidas que la transicion esta esperando.

control_automatic.description: El control del usuario lo dio la interfaz (vista en vivo entre turnos); la primera accion del agente lo recupera.

hostBrowserBinding.description: Resultado de host.browser.register. Reservado a main; no se expone por preload.

hostBrowserRequest.description: Carga del evento efimero host.browser.request. Identidad completa: el receptor valida todo antes de tocar una pagina (doc 03 Â§5.3).

hostBrowserReply.description: Parametros de host.browser.reply. Replica la correlacion; una respuesta vieja no satisface una solicitud nueva.

hostBrowserEvent.description: Parametros de host.browser.event: cambios de pestana y perdidas de control, acotados a su contexto.

current_task_snapshot.description: Foto del grafo de tareas actual cuya ventana toca esta etapa. No es el estado histÃ³rico de la etapa: sÃ³lo alimenta el progreso mientras la etapa estÃ¡ viva.

partial_progress.description: Promedio de las etapas conocidas. Es parcial por definiciÃ³n y no se presenta como progreso total.

progress_coverage.description: Con quÃ© parte del flujo se calculÃ³ `progress`. Si falta alguna etapa, `progress` es null y esto dice cuÃ¡ntas se conocen.

runtime.description: How the provider is reached: 'http' or an external runtime id such as 'claude-cli'.

requires_external_binary.description: Executable the user must install themselves; null for HTTP providers.

auth_kind.description: Who runs the login: absent for Rinari-managed OAuth, 'external-cli' when an external CLI owns the authentication.

managed_by.description: Runtime that owns the login when auth_kind is 'external-cli'.

mcpSecretState.description: State of a secret: never its value.

mcpServer.description: mcp.list/get/create/update/enable/disable/reconnect view. Secrets appear only as mcpSecretState (configured/source/env_var), never as values. `status` and `connection` come from the Engine's live connection (mcp_background_connect_v1).

url_secret.description: Present when the URL's query carried a secret: the whole URL is in the credential store and `url` shows those values as ***.

project_root.description: The folder a project-scope server belongs to (mcp_catalog_v1); null: visible in every trusted project.

owner.description: agency_agents_v1: "agent:ID" when the account belongs to an agent, seen only by that agent; null: everyone's.

auth.description: kind oauth adds client_id (public), client_secret (state only), scopes, redirect_port, client_metadata_url and authorize_params; tokens are never part of the view (mcp.auth.status).

mcpConnectionStatus.description: idle: enabled, not tried yet (a project server waits for its trusted project). reauth_required: renewing the sign-in failed; the owner reconnects it.

mcpConnection.description: Why a server is in its state. Also the payload of mcp.status.changed, with `name` and `status`. `message` never carries a secret.

mcpTestResult.description: mcp.test / mcp.probe diagnosis. Connection failures are reported here, never raised. `error` and `serverInfo` are legacy aliases.

oauth.description: http servers with auth none/oauth: OAuth found even without a 401 (null: none).

networkSettings.description: network.settings.get/set (plan 0.4.0 #96, «Red»): proxy and certificates of every outgoing HTTP client, saved in ~/.rinari/network.json. set takes `proxy` and/or `certificates` (each replaces its saved object; a missing one is kept) and returns the same shape as get.

mode.description: system: environment variables and the OS proxy (default); manual: `url`; none: direct.

bypass.description: Hosts that skip a manual proxy (localhost is always direct).

mode.description: system: the OS store via truststore (default); certifi: the bundled store; file: only the PEM at `path`.

networkTestResult.description: One row of network.test: one GET without credentials to an enabled provider's base URL through the network settings. Any answer below 500 (except 407) is ok; the whole test ends within ~10 s.

networkEffective.description: What the clients use now. Proxy credentials are redacted. `error`: why a broken network.json fell back to the defaults.

extra.description: SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR also trusted with the system store.

networkTest.description: network.test result: one row per enabled provider with an HTTP endpoint (params: optional `provider_ids`), and the network settings in use.

soulSettings.description: soul.settings.get/set: character intensity, separate from Soul selection.

remote_pending.description: The GitHub part is being read; repo.status.updated follows.

imageCreationSettings.description: images.settings.get / images.settings.set (plan 0.4.0 #28). Connectors never carry a secret: set takes an optional `api_key` per OpenAI connector and keeps only its credential reference.

api_key.description: Write-only: stored in the credential store.

workflows.description: ComfyUI: workflow (API format) per operation; {{prompt}} and {{image}} are replaced.

tools.description: MCP: tool per operation and its argument names.

mcpAuthError.description: An OAuth failure: stable code and hint, never a token, code or secret.

mcpOAuthSupport.description: What OAuth discovery found for a remote MCP server (mcp.test/mcp.probe `oauth`, mcp.auth.start). `client` says what signing in needs: configured (the owner's client is set), registration (RFC 7591), metadata_document (CIMD) or required (the owner must add a client ID).

mcpAuthStart.description: mcp.auth.start result. The sign-in goes on in the browser; it ends with mcp.auth.finished.

mcpAuthOutcome.description: How a sign-in ended (mcp.auth.finished payload without `name`; mcp.auth.status `last`).

mcpAuthStatus.description: mcp.auth.status: sign-in flags, expiry and scopes; never a token.

mcpAuthSignout.description: mcp.auth.signout: tokens revoked (when the server can) and deleted.

mcpToolHints.description: MCP tool annotations that the policy reads (connectors plan C5). null: not declared (in `owner`, the key is simply absent).

mcpToolPermission.description: mcp.tools.list/set: one tool of an MCP server with its permissions (mcp_tool_permissions_v1). `annotations.server` are the server's hints, `owner` the owner's corrections and `effective` what counts. `setting` is the owner's choice for this tool; `decision` and `decision_source` say what applies (tool, server default, or the mode's rule when null). `by_mode` is what each mode does before any external content; full-access only blocks what the owner blocked. `listed`: false for a saved setting of a tool the server no longer lists (or before it connected).

sends_out.description: A call may send data outside (not a read and openWorldHint is not false): after external content from another source it asks in workspace.

mcpToolPermissions.description: mcp.tools.list/set/set_default `server`: the server's default (Allow / Ask / Block for tools without their own setting; null: the mode decides) and its tools from the last tools/list (nothing connects to answer).

mcpCatalogText.description: A catalog text in Spanish and English.

mcpCatalogEntry.description: mcp.catalog.list entry: a connector the Engine ships (src/rinari/mcp/catalog.json, schema catalog.schema.json). `added` and `servers` say which saved servers match it (same URL or command).

logo.description: An identifier for the client's own artwork; the Engine ships no images.

mcpCatalogAdd.description: mcp.catalog.add result. `next`: sign_in (call mcp.auth.start) or connect (already connecting in the background).

mcpImportSecret.description: A secret an imported definition brings: where and its name, never its value. `kind` env_ref is an env://NAME reference (from ${VAR}).

variable.description: For env_ref: the owner's environment variable it reads (its name, never its value).

mcpImportCandidate.description: A server found by mcp.import.scan or offered by mcp.project_offers.list. Shape and secret names only. `reason` (not importable): legacy_sse_unsupported, secret_in_command, unresolved_variable, invalid_url, invalid_definition. `warnings`: disabled_in_source, unresolved_variable:<field>, invalid_env_name, cwd_ignored, env_file_ignored.

existing.description: A saved server with the same definition, if any.

changed.description: Project offers: the definition changed since the owner answered.

mcpImportSource.description: A config file mcp.import.scan looked at (Windows, macOS or Linux paths of each app).

mcpImportResult.description: mcp.import.apply and mcp.project_offers.decide: what was created and what failed (each server on its own).

mcpProjectOffers.description: mcp.project_offers.list: servers a trusted folder brings that the owner has not answered (once per server). Untrusted: trusted false and no offers.
